title: Acceptance and transition answer
statement: Let $N$ be a nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean input alphabet, let $x$ be a finite Boolean input, and let $st$ be a verifier state, with positions $p,p'\in\mathbb{N}$ and Boolean lists $u,u'$. The function returns true exactly when $st$ is accepting and at least one of the two transition choices (false or true) moves the input head from position $p$ to $p'$ and satisfies the corresponding completion condition, using the scan result on $u,u'$ for that choice.
hypotheses_covered: A nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean input alphabet
caveat: The meanings of acceptance, head movement, completion, and scanning are determined by upstream machine definitions not included among the supplied informal definitions.
